seoDescription: Latest news and updates from Tianbo Electronics including new relay releases and company updates.

news.title: Tianbo Expands High-Voltage DC Relay Series
news.summary: Tianbo announces new TRNA-270A enhanced high-voltage relay for EV charging applications.
news.content: Tianbo Electronics has expanded its high-voltage DC relay portfolio with the new TRNA-270A enhanced series. The new relays feature improved contact design for extended life and are optimized for EV charging infrastructure and grid-scale energy storage applications.

news.title: Tianbo Achieves Enhanced Automotive Certification
news.summary: HJR-78F series receives enhanced AEC-Q200 qualification for automotive applications.
news.content: Tianbo Electronics is pleased to announce that its HJR-78F series automotive relays have enhanced AEC-Q200 qualification. This certification enables automotive manufacturers to use these components with confidence in critical vehicle applications requiring extended temperature range and enhanced reliability.
